description: Shared flow feature schema computed identically by PCAP flow extractor and CICIDS2017 CSV preprocessor.

features.name: flow_duration
features.description: Duration of the flow in microseconds

features.name: total_fwd_packets
features.description: Total packets in the forward direction

features.name: total_bwd_packets
features.description: Total packets in the backward direction

features.name: total_length_of_fwd_packets
features.description: Total byte length of forward packets

features.name: total_length_of_bwd_packets
features.description: Total byte length of backward packets

features.name: min_packet_length
features.description: Minimum packet length in the flow

features.name: max_packet_length
features.description: Maximum packet length in the flow

features.name: packet_length_mean
features.description: Mean packet length in the flow

features.name: packet_length_std
features.description: Standard deviation of packet length in the flow

features.name: flow_iat_mean
features.description: Mean inter-arrival time between packets in microseconds

features.name: fin_flag_count
features.description: Number of packets with TCP FIN flag

features.name: syn_flag_count
features.description: Number of packets with TCP SYN flag

features.name: rst_flag_count
features.description: Number of packets with TCP RST flag

features.name: psh_flag_count
features.description: Number of packets with TCP PSH flag

features.name: ack_flag_count
features.description: Number of packets with TCP ACK flag
